steps.name: journal-check
steps.probe: (async()=>{const {plus,tracker}=window.__notes;await tracker.flush();const before=document.getElementById('screen').toDataURL();plus.open();plus.selectTab('journal');await tracker.flush();const body=document.getElementById('por-plus-content');if(tracker.slot!=='C'||!tracker.notes.some(n=>n.kind==='text')||!tracker.notes.some(n=>n.kind==='area'))throw Error('missing real diary events');if(!body.textContent.includes('Save slot C')||!body.textContent.includes(tracker.notes.find(n=>n.kind==='text').text))throw Error('diary not rendered');await tracker.addNote('Synthetic acceptance pin',{pin:true});if(!body.textContent.includes('Synthetic acceptance pin'))throw Error('personal note not rendered');plus.close();if(before!==document.getElementById('screen').toDataURL())throw Error('canvas changed');const {createStore}=await import('/plus/store.js');const saved=await createStore({profile:'por',slot:'C'}).get('notes');if(saved.notes.length!==tracker.notes.length)throw Error('IDB persistence');return {pass:true,slot:tracker.slot,notes:tracker.notes.length,kinds:[...new Set(tracker.notes.map(n=>n.kind))],canvasUnchanged:true};})()
